summary: Added regression tests to verify that Todo.__repr__ correctly handles multi-byte UTF-8 characters. Python 3 strings are Unicode strings and slicing by character index is inherently UTF-8 safe - it never cuts multi-byte characters in half.

changes.description: New test file with 5 regression tests verifying UTF-8 handling in Todo.__repr__

risks: None - the original code was already correct. Python 3 string slicing operates on Unicode code points, not bytes.
verification_steps: Created tests for emoji text (4-byte UTF-8 characters)
Created tests for CJK text (3-byte UTF-8 characters)
Created tests for accented characters (2-byte UTF-8 characters)
Created tests for mixed ASCII and multi-byte text
Created tests for complex emoji (surrogate pairs)
All tests verify UTF-8 round-trip encoding/decoding
